Name: Volcano shop sells Dragon Tooth and more
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Volcano Shop Sells Dragon Tooth and more. Do you feel like you can never find a dragon tooth? Are you about to run out of time to complete Fragments of the Past special order?
This mod adds items found in the Volcano to the Volcano shop.
Adds:
Cinder Shard
Magma Cap
Dragon Tooth
Bone Fragments //Buying from the Volcano Dwarf does count towards Fragment of the Past special order. 
Solar Essence
Prices are configurable. 

V2.0 adds items found in chests: 
Weapons (You have the choice to include or not.)
Dwarf Sword
Dwarf Hammer
Dwarf Dagger
Dragon Tooth Cutless
Dragon Tooth Club
Dragon Tooth Shiv

Other chest items (You have the choice to include or not.)
Golden Coconut
Protection Ring
Soul Sapper Ring
Mermaid Boots
Dragon Scale Boots
Phoenix Ring
Hot Java Ring
Deluxe Pirate Hat
Ostrich Egg
Curiosity Lure
Warp Totem Island
Golden Animal Cracker

[b]Translations[/b]
Translations are welcome. 
Russian translation by Bromgek
